name: Quick Sell
teaser: Quick-sell to the best trader or the flea, with prices on item tooltips.
description:
SPT 4.1.3 port of QuickSell. All credit goes to the original author.

Original mod: TadMaj
Multiselect interop: Tyfon (UI Fixes)
Price tooltip approach inspired by: SwiftXP (Show Me The Money)
License: MIT (unchanged)

This port keeps QuickSell available on SPT 4.1.3. If TadMaj asks me to remove it or publishes their own 4.1 version, I will take this page down.

What it does

  • Right-click a stash item to sell it to the best paying trader or list it on the flea.
  • Use the N flea and M trader keybinds.
  • See trader and flea prices when hovering over items.
  • Sell multiple selected items with UI Fixes.

Installation

Extract the ZIP into your SPT root folder. Client files go in BepInEx\plugins\QuickSell\; server files go in SPT_Runtime\user\mods\QuickSell\.

Requires SPT 4.1.3. UI Fixes 6.0.0+ is optional for multi-select selling. The server component is recommended for flea prices in raid.

Fika Headless

Install the QuickSell client plugin on playing PCs only. Do not install QuickSell.dll in BepInEx\plugins on the headless PC. If your SPT server runs on that PC, keep the server component in SPT_Runtime\user\mods\QuickSell\.

Configuration

QuickSell settings are in the F12 menu. Tier colours are in BepInEx\plugins\QuickSell\config.json.

Uninstalling

Delete BepInEx\plugins\QuickSell\ and SPT_Runtime\user\mods\QuickSell\. Nothing is written to your profile.
